text_block_list.text:
I was... no match for... Ayabe. She's so
strong...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Her strength doesn't stop at maintaining
massive
leads over the others. It also
shows in her passion,
and this race
proved it.

I'm sure... you knew this all along,
Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
It wasn't my time to take on the Derby.
But... this
has been a memorable
experience, nonetheless.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I want to say my thanks, but I'm too
much of a
coward to do anything...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I'm the same as ever—slow, wimpy, and
clumsy.
But I realized... I don't want to
stay like this.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes... Maybe I can't smile at this
experience
just yet, but...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
One day, I hope to find the fun in big
races like
this, so I can... walk away
smiling... Nghhh...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото experiences a chapter of
defeat in
her story. But, perhaps it is a
chapter that will
lead to better things.
